reference.title: Scenario: inheritance in maps

section.p: In this map structure, the child topics t_manage_users.dita, t_configure_permissions.dita, and r_admin_api.dita automatically inherit the audience="admin" attribute from their parent. Writers don't need to apply this attribute to each topic individually. The hierarchy handles it.
This reduces redundancy and ensures consistency across large documentation sets. If the audience classification changes, updating the parent updates all children.
